title: Tablya — Food Photography & Content Production Egypt | admepro
desc: admepro designed the Tablya brand identity — a warm, authentic visual concept for an Egyptian food brand that celebrates local cuisine and culture.
content: P: Tablya brings the rich flavors of oriental cuisine to the international dining scene from its home in Oman. Our collaboration focused on creating captivating social media photography that showcases their authentic dishes and unique dining experience. Each image was crafted to tell the story of their culinary expertise, helping establish their presence as a distinguished international restaurant brand.
